provenance.diagnostic: per-process aggregates of the 4 Mi phases' [heap] frames (README.md, "Diagnostic: the 4 Mi phases' physical frames"); no frame number is recorded

run1.privilege: sudo -n on each per-process perf stat + phase_probe command

run2.privilege: sudo -n on each per-process perf stat + phase_probe command

estimators.ratio: none: no ratio is published from this file
estimators.columns: Per process: L1D-miss loads and cycles per operation from perf stat; contiguity = 1 - runs/present pages; colour imbalance = max over mean of the 32 L2 page-colour counts; colour CV = their standard deviation over mean. The reading is Spearman's rho between each property and L1D-miss loads per operation over N's 24 processes per shape and run; no interval and no ratio.
